summaries.zh: DSH's built-in `session-query` searches DSH's own sessions. dsh-deja answers the other question: what you did in the twenty other coding agents on this machine — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode and the rest. It indexes the session files those agents already write to disk, so the months before installation are searchable from the first second; recall, a per-session digest, per-file history and "what ran after this error last time" arrive as tools, plus optional automatic recall before each s
